entities.name: Spurna
entities.description: Goblin embermage, head of the embermages of Squee's kingdom, secretly compleated by Phyrexia; died in the explosion.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: Goblin king whose kingdom Spurna served.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: Agent of Phyrexia who compromised Spurna.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Invading power whose sleeper agents infiltrated the goblins.

entities.name: Goblin mountain
entities.description: The goblins' mountain home, lit by mana lamps and destroyed by explosions.

entities.name: Mana lamps
entities.description: Lamps illuminating the goblins' mountain, tended by Spurna.

events.summary: Squee orders the mana lamps extinguished for a celebration; Spurna warns him of the danger but follows the order.
events.quote: he ordered the extinguishing of the mana lamps for a celebration

events.summary: Spurna is revealed as a traitor compromised by Ertai and attacks Squee.
events.quote: In a shocking betrayal, she attacked Squee

events.summary: A partially compleated Squee accidentally sets off the mana torches; explosions destroy the mountain, killing all the goblins inside including Spurna.
events.quote: a chain of explosions annihilated the mountain the goblins lived in, killing all the goblins inside, Spurna included

relations.note: compromised by him and allied to his cause
relations.quote: having been compromised by Ertai , an agent of Phyrexia
In a shocking betrayal, she attacked Squee
